key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:16EC
name: read_decimal_digit_value
description: Reads one character and returns its numeric value when it is an ASCII digit, otherwise returns an error code of 1. On a digit it also advances a counter that is passed in by pointer.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:18B0
name: parse_lha_command_options
description: Walks the option string given to the LhA archiver, handling single-letter switches and extended options, and prints the invalid option messages for unknown ones. When a task priority is given it reads the current task and applies that priority, falling back to the default if the value is invalid.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1B88
name: set_lha_mode_flags
description: Derives several option flags from a single mode letter in the state block and resets the header level to zero when it falls outside 0 to 2, reporting that with the bad header level message. It also checks whether standard input is interactive.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1CC0
name: jump_to_shared_routine
description: A single-instruction stub that forwards control to another routine with no arguments of its own. It holds no logic of its own.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1CC8
name: release_open_files_and_locks
description: Walks three fixed tables of file records and locks, closing or unlocking each active entry and deleting a flagged temporary file by name. It also restores the saved current directory before returning the last result.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1F08
name: open_file_into_free_slot
description: Finds the first empty entry among the ten file slots and opens a file into it through the DOS open call. It returns the new handle, or zero when every slot is in use.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1F4E
name: close_file_handle_slot
description: Finds the slot holding the given file handle among the ten file slots, closes that handle through the DOS close call, and clears the slot.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1F8E
name: lock_file_into_free_slot
description: Finds the first empty entry among sixty-four lock slots and takes a DOS lock on a file, storing the returned lock handle there. It returns that handle, or zero when every slot is full.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1FD4
name: store_lock_handle_in_table
description: Stores the value passed in the data register into the first empty entry of the sixty-four-entry lock table. It does nothing when the table is full.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1FE2
name: store_value_at_list_length
description: Counts the non-zero entries in a caller-supplied list of up to sixty-four pointers and stores the value passed in another register at that index of the lock table.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1FFA
name: store_value_at_lock_index
description: Writes the value passed in one data register into the lock table at the index held in another data register. There is no bounds check.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:200E
name: unlock_and_clear_lock_entry
description: Finds the lock table entry matching the given handle, clears it, and unlocks the file through the DOS unlock call. It then calls a second routine to finish the release.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2052
name: prepare_temporary_file_name
description: Copies a name string from the state block into a local buffer and calls routines around that copy. The referenced text LhATmp. marks the temporary file name.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:228A
name: allocate_file_entry_record
description: Finds a free entry in the ten-slot file table and allocates a record for it. It then fills the record's fields from the mode letter and the arguments, storing a size when the mode is one that carries one.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:22A0
name: scan_and_allocate_file_entry
description: Scans the ten-slot file table for a free entry, allocates a record there, and fills its fields from the mode letter. It returns null if no slot is free or allocation fails.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:22CC
name: allocate_record_and_set_fields
description: Allocates one entry record, fills its size and attribute fields from the mode letter, and adjusts a flag word based on the option letter. A lock is taken when the mode asks for write access.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:22DE
name: set_entry_fields_from_mode
description: Fills the size, mode and flag fields of an existing entry record from the mode letter. It calls routines to obtain or lock the file when write or size options are set.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2308
name: reset_entry_and_apply_mode
description: Clears the size and flag fields of an entry record, then applies the mode letter to set its flag bits and its mode value. It takes a lock first when write options are set.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2354
name: finish_entry_mode_flags
description: Applies the mode letter as flag bits on an entry record and, when a required flag is clear, obtains a value through a routine call and stores it in the record. It returns early if that value is null.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2370
name: release_then_finish_entry
description: Releases a held file handle when one is passed in, applies the mode letter to the entry's flags, and reads file attributes through the DOS examine call.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23A0
name: apply_mode_letter_to_entry
description: Runs an initial routine, then applies the mode letter to an entry's flag bits and chooses a value for a flag word. The letters M, m, T and t each set a distinct bit or option value.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23D4
name: fill_entry_record_fields
description: Sets the first two words of an entry record from its flag bits, fetching values through routines or zeroing them, and then sets its size and offset fields. It returns early when a required value cannot be obtained.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23D8
name: fetch_entry_value_once
description: Sets the first two words of an entry record from its flag bits, fetching a value through a routine without a retry. It then sets the entry's size and offset fields, returning early if the fetch fails.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23DC
name: set_entry_flags_then_fill
description: Sets a group of flag bits on an entry record, then runs the standard field-filling sequence that fetches its values and clears its counters.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23E6
name: set_alt_flags_then_fill
description: Sets a different group of flag bits on an entry record, then runs the standard field-filling sequence that fetches its values and clears its counters.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23F0
name: set_entry_hold_flag_fill
description: Sets the top bit of the mode flags on an entry record, then fills its fields and size values without a second fetch.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23FA
name: set_flag_retry_fill
description: Sets the top bit of the mode flags on an entry record, then fills its fields, retrying the second value fetch when the first returns null.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2424
name: fetch_entry_value_with_retry
description: Clears a field of an entry record and fetches a value through a routine, retrying once when the mode value asks for it. It then fills the size and offset fields and returns early on failure.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:243E
name: link_entry_into_file_table
description: Fetches a value for an entry record, retrying once for mode 1, and fills its size fields on success. It then stores the record in the file table slot selected by the state counter, or releases the record when the fetch fails.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2482
name: register_entry_with_position
description: Clears the first field of an entry record, obtains a file position through a library call, and stores the record in the file table slot selected by the state counter.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:24E6
name: release_entry_record_and_file
description: Releases an entry record by closing or deleting its file when the flags require it, freeing its attached buffers, and clearing its slot in the file table. The file is deleted through the DOS delete call when marked for removal.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2564
name: find_block_containing_offset
description: Searches a table of up to 128 stored address ranges for the one that contains the given offset, and moves to that range when it differs from the current one. If the entry has no range table it falls back to a plain seek call.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:261C
name: open_next_archive_volume
description: Builds the file name of the next multi-volume archive part from a numbered pattern and opens it. It reports an error that names the file when the volume cannot be opened, and updates the volume counter in the entry record.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2736
name: refill_entry_buffer_block
description: Makes sure an entry has a buffer, then reads the next block from its file when the buffered data is used up. It marks the entry with an error flag and returns minus one when the allocation fails.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2764
name: refill_buffer_without_allocation
description: Refills an entry's existing buffer when its remaining data is used up, reading the next block through a routine and updating the offset fields. It returns minus one when the read fails.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2790
name: read_block_into_buffer
description: Allocates the entry buffer when one is needed and reads the next block into it, updating the buffer position fields. On a read failure it stores the DOS error code and returns minus one.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:27C2
name: refill_and_read_chunk
description: Refills an entry's buffer if needed, then advances its offset past the consumed data and reads the next chunk through the DOS read call. It records the DOS error code and returns minus one on failure.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:27E4
name: read_chunk_into_entry
description: Advances an entry's offset past the consumed data and reads the next chunk through the DOS read call. It returns the number of bytes read.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2814
name: flush_entry_buffer_to_file
description: Writes the buffered data of an output entry to its file when the write flag is set, allocating the buffer when needed. On a failed write it records the DOS error code and returns minus one.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:28FC
name: seek_within_entry_buffer
description: Moves an entry's read position to a new offset, treating the argument as absolute or relative according to the mode value. It refills the buffer when the target lies outside the current window and returns minus one for an invalid mode.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2912
name: seek_entry_position_by_mode
description: Moves an entry's position to a new offset, treating the argument as absolute or relative according to the mode value. It refills the buffer when the target falls outside the current window and returns minus one for an invalid mode.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2928
name: reposition_entry_buffer
description: Sets an entry's read offset to the target value passed in. It refills the buffer through a routine when the target lies outside the current window, and otherwise only adjusts the offset inside the window.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:292C
name: reposition_entry_relative
description: Adds two offset values to get a target position, then moves the entry there the same way as its neighbours, refilling the buffer when the target falls outside the current window.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2932
name: stub_return_failure
description: Returns minus one and does nothing else.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2936
name: set_entry_offset_refill
description: Sets an entry's read offset to the value passed in, refilling the buffer through a routine when that offset lies outside the current window. It returns early when the refill fails.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2954
name: reset_entry_buffer_window
description: Starts an entry's buffer window at the offset passed in, clears its used count, and marks its end as unknown before calling a routine.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2966
name: set_buffer_used_count
description: Sets the used-byte count of an entry's buffer to the offset passed in minus the window start, then calls a routine to synchronise the buffer.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:29E0
name: read_bytes_from_entry
description: Reads up to the requested number of bytes from an entry into a caller buffer, refilling through a routine as needed. When the entry holds no data it marks the entry as at end of data and returns minus one.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A00
name: consume_entry_bytes
description: Consumes a requested count of bytes from an entry's buffer, refilling when the buffer runs dry and marking the entry at end of data when none remain.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A14
name: copy_entry_data_to_buffer
description: Repeatedly copies data from an entry's buffer into a destination area, refilling when the buffer runs dry and advancing both position counters until the requested amount is copied or the data ends.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A22
name: copy_entry_until_end
description: Copies data from an entry into a destination buffer until the requested count is met or the entry runs out, setting its end-of-data flag when it reaches the end.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A30
name: copy_entry_chunks_memory
description: Copies an entry's data into memory in chunks using the system memory-copy routine, advancing its buffer window after each chunk. It returns the number of bytes copied.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A6E
name: copy_entry_blocks_memory
description: Copies data out of an entry in successive blocks through the system memory-copy routine, advancing the source window and the running total each time, until a zero-length request ends the transfer.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A9C
name: fill_output_entry_bytes
description: Writes a count of bytes into an output entry's buffer, flushing through a routine when the buffer fills and marking the entry as modified. It returns the number of bytes written, or minus one on a failed flush.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2ABC
name: write_output_chunks
description: Continues writing data into an output entry while bytes remain, flushing through a routine whenever the buffer fills and setting the modified flag each time. It returns the total number of bytes written.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2AC6
name: flush_output_until_done
description: Repeats an output step while data remains, flushing the buffer through a routine each time it fills. It returns minus one if a flush fails.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2AD6
name: copy_into_output_buffer
description: Copies bytes from a source into an output entry's buffer using the system memory-copy routine, flushing when the buffer reaches its limit. It returns the total number of bytes handled.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2B20
name: copy_bytes_to_output_entry
description: Copies a block of bytes into an output entry through the system memory-copy routine, extending its recorded length and marking the entry as modified. It returns the number of bytes copied.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2FCE
name: write_byte_to_output
description: Stores one byte, passed in a data register, in an output entry's buffer and extends its recorded length. It flushes the buffer through a routine when it reaches its limit, and returns minus one if the entry is in an error state or the flush fails.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2FF0
name: store_byte_in_entry
description: Appends one byte, passed in a data register, to an entry's buffer and updates the recorded length. It flushes the buffer through a routine once the buffer is full.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2FFC
name: append_byte_flush_result
description: Appends one byte to an entry's buffer and updates its recorded length. It calls a routine to flush the buffer when it is full and returns that flush result.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3032
name: stub_return_success
description: Returns zero and does nothing else.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:303A
name: read_byte_from_entry
description: Returns the next byte from an entry's buffer and advances its read position. When no byte is left it sets the entry's end-of-data flag and returns minus one.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3052
name: read_byte_unchecked
description: Returns the byte at an entry's current read position and advances the position. It performs no end-of-data check.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:30B4
name: run_setup_once_on_flag
description: Tests a status word from a library call and, when a particular bit is set and a one-time marker is clear, runs two setup calls and sets the marker so they run only once.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:30BA
name: run_calls_return_code
description: Runs a sequence of library calls and returns a one-byte result code. When that code is three it calls one more routine to finish.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:30C0
name: forward_to_shared_routine
description: A single-instruction stub that forwards control to another routine with no arguments of its own. It holds no logic of its own.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F64
name: append_path_component
description: Appends a source string to a destination path, inserting a slash separator first unless the destination is empty or already ends with a colon or slash. It copies the source including its terminator.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F6A
name: unlink_list_node
description: Removes a node from a doubly linked list by pointing its two neighbours at each other.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F70
name: scan_path_for_separator
description: Scans a path string backwards for a directory or device separator and stops at the first one it finds. It returns no value.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F7C
name: duplicate_string_allocated
description: Measures a string, allocates a buffer of that size through a routine, and copies the string into it. It returns the new buffer, or null when allocation fails.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F82
name: allocate_block_with_quit_prompt
description: Tries to allocate a memory block of the requested size and returns it with its size field set. When allocation fails it reads a character and quits when that character is Q or q.
